europe_now.title: Serbian Student Movement Secures Parliamentary Majority
europe_now.summary: Serbia's student-led opposition has won a parliamentary majority, setting the stage for a major political transition and an upcoming presidential contest. The incumbent administration conceded defeat following the electoral breakthrough.

sources.headline: Serbian student movement eyes power after election triumph
Serbia’s student protestors win parliamentary majority – setting scene for showdown with Vučić for December’s presidential poll

europe_now.title: French Government Faces Continued Student Protests
europe_now.summary: Student unions in France are maintaining their mobilization and calling for ongoing demonstrations despite meetings with government officials. President Macron has pledged to introduce concrete measures to address the protesters' demands.

sources.headline: French government fails to convince students to stop protests
Macron promises 'concrete measures' in response to French students' demands

top_stories.title: European Defense Warnings on Russia
top_stories.summary: European defense ministers have issued public warnings regarding the security situation in the region. Officials stated that current indications show leadership in Moscow is not genuinely pursuing peace.
